description: Styles in the page's scoped <style> (e.g. .member-card-company, .member-collaboration-card) don't apply to member cards, which are rendered by JS via innerHTML and so lack Astro's scope attribute
steps_to_reproduce: Open /anetaret/ and look at a card for a member with a company
expected: Company line small (12px), bold, accent colour
actual: Company line renders at default body size/colour

description: The sticky-note styles in the page's scoped <style> (.unified-feed>.idea-row note colours, tilt, tape) never apply: the feed items come from set:html, so they lack Astro's scope attribute and render as plain white directory.css cards
steps_to_reproduce: Open /rrjeti/postimet/ and look at the board
expected: Ideas shown as tilted coloured sticky notes on the cork board
actual: Ideas shown as ordinary white cards with a coloured left border
